content_sections.heading: Gender Specialist Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the recruitment under the District Hub for Empowerment of Women.

content_sections.heading: Gender Specialist Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be citizens of India.

rows.qualification_required: Graduation in Social Work / other Social Science subjects (Sociology / Rural Development / Rural Management / LSW / Psychology / Women's Studies) with a minimum of 3 years of working experience in government or non-government organisations in gender-centric subjects.

content_sections.heading: Gender Specialist Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for the Gender Specialist post is 21 to 40 years . Reservation policy as implemented by the General Administration Department of Bihar is applicable. Age relaxation will be given to eligible candidates who are permanent residents of Bihar.

content_sections.heading: Gender Specialist Salary
content_sections.text: Selected employees will receive EPF and ESIC as per rules in addition to the consolidated monthly remuneration.

content_sections.heading: Gender Specialist Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of scrutiny of educational qualifications, work experience, and an interview. Shortlisting of candidates based on required educational qualifications and work experience. Interview for shortlisted candidates. Preference will be given to candidates possessing computer operation knowledge and work experience in government departments or offices. Final merit list publication.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gender Specialist Munger
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website munger.nic.in . Fill out the application form with correct details. Attach self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, and paste a self-attested passport-size photograph on the application form. Clearly mention the name of the applied post on the envelope. Send the application via Registered Post or Speed Post to the address: Nodal Officer-cum-District Programme Officer, ICDS, Civil Court Premises, Munger, PIN- 811201. Alternatively, send the application via email to [email protected] on or before 24 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Gender Specialist Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment on a contractual basis is completely temporary and can be terminated with a 15-day prior notice. Selected individuals will not be considered government servants and cannot claim regularisation of service in the future. Candidates must write the name of the applied post on top of the application envelope if applying by post. Applications received after the closing time and date will not be accepted. No separate correspondence or call letters will be sent individually except for publishing the interview schedule list on the website. Preference will be given to candidates with computer knowledge and work experience in government departments.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting DSWO Munger Gender Specialist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Social Welfare Office Munger (Mahila Evam Bal Vikas Nigam, Munger) under Mission Shakti.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Gender Specialist post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Gender Specialist post reserved for the EBC category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Gender Specialist Munger Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 24 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Gender Specialist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a graduation degree in Social Work or other Social Science subjects (Sociology, Rural Development, Rural Management, LSW, Psychology, Women's Studies) along with at least 3 years of work experience in gender-centric subjects.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Gender Specialist recruitment?
faq.answer: The age of candidates must be between 21 and 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DSWO Munger Gender Specialist recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the DSWO Munger Gender Specialist post?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply offline by sending their filled application form via registered post/speed post to the Nodal Officer address or by emailing it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Gender Specialist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 23,000/- along with EPF and ESIC.

faq.question: Q9. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The exact date of the interview has not been specified in the notification and will be announced later through the official website.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this appointment is purely temporary and contractual under Mission Shakti, and selected candidates will not be considered regular government employees.
